works.title: On the Unity of Christ
works.subtitle: Popular Patristics Series
works.author: Cyril of Alexandria
works.blurb: Cyril's mature statement of the union of natures in the one incarnate Word, the doctrinal voice that carried the day at Ephesus and shaped the Chalcedonian definition. John McGuckin's translation.

works.title: Commentary on John, Vol. 1
works.subtitle: Ancient Christian Texts
works.author: Cyril of Alexandria
works.blurb: Books 1–6 of Cyril's twelve-book exegesis of the Fourth Gospel, the first complete modern English translation. David R. Maxwell, working from Pusey's critical Greek text, restores the work to general readability.

works.title: Commentary on John, Vol. 2
works.subtitle: Ancient Christian Texts
works.author: Cyril of Alexandria
works.blurb: Books 7–12 of the Commentary on John, completing Maxwell's translation, including Cyril's exposition of the Last Supper discourses, the high-priestly prayer, and the Resurrection appearances.

works.title: Three Christological Treatises
works.subtitle: Fathers of the Church, Vol. 129
works.author: Cyril of Alexandria
works.publisher: The Catholic University of America Press
works.blurb: On Orthodoxy to Theodosius, Defense against the Bishops of Oriens, and Defense against Theodoret, the three works in which Cyril explained his Twelve Anathemas to the Emperor and his critics on the eve of Ephesus. Daniel King's translation, the first into English.

works.title: Letters 1–50
works.subtitle: Fathers of the Church, Vol. 76
works.author: Cyril of Alexandria
works.publisher: The Catholic University of America Press
works.blurb: The first half of Cyril's surviving correspondence, including the Second Letter to Nestorius, the Third Letter with the Twelve Anathemas, and the Letter to John of Antioch that sealed the Formulary of Reunion. John I. McEnerney's translation.

works.title: Letters 51–110
works.subtitle: Fathers of the Church, Vol. 77
works.author: Cyril of Alexandria
works.publisher: The Catholic University of America Press
works.blurb: The second and final volume of McEnerney's translation of Cyril's letters, Christological clarifications after the Reunion of 433, pastoral correspondence, and the Letter to Eulogius on the proper reception of the Antiochene formula.

works.title: Festal Letters 1–12
works.subtitle: Fathers of the Church, Vol. 118
works.author: Cyril of Alexandria
works.publisher: The Catholic University of America Press
works.blurb: The annual Paschal letters by which the Alexandrian patriarch announced the date of Pascha and prepared his flock for the great fast, Cyril's pastoral voice, year by year, on repentance, almsgiving, and the meaning of the Resurrection. Philip Amidon's translation.

works.title: Festal Letters 13–30
works.subtitle: Fathers of the Church, Vol. 127
works.author: Cyril of Alexandria
works.publisher: The Catholic University of America Press
works.blurb: The remaining festal letters Cyril sent across his patriarchate, including the letters of the years through and beyond Ephesus, in which the Christological controversy enters his Paschal preaching.

works.title: Cyril of Alexandria
works.subtitle: The Early Church Fathers
works.author: Norman Russell
works.blurb: Russell's introduction to Cyril's life, method, and theology, with fresh translations of selections from the major works, the Commentary on John, the Christological treatises, the Against Julian, and the Letters. The standard scholarly entry point.

works.title: Saint Cyril of Alexandria and the Christological Controversy
works.subtitle: Its History, Theology, and Texts
works.author: John A. McGuckin
works.blurb: McGuckin's standard study of the fifth-century clash between Cyril and Nestorius, political, theological, and personal, with key primary texts in translation.

works.title: The Appropriation of Divine Life in Cyril of Alexandria
works.subtitle: Oxford Theological Monographs
works.author: Daniel A. Keating
works.blurb: Keating's comprehensive account of sanctification and deification in Cyril, drawn from the New Testament commentaries and homilies. The definitive monograph on the soteriology that runs beneath Cyril's Christology.
